scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(ua.startsWith('pnpm/')){process.exit(0)} try{require('fs').unlinkSync('package-lock.json');}catch(e){} try{require('fs').unlinkSync('yarn.lock');}catch(e){} console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
